policy: Frozen research only. Candidates, including high confidence, are not confirmed until independently reviewed and integrated into the catalog.

proposals.summary: Sets the scene area-change request bit without starting or waiting for the transition.

evidence.detail: Sets bit 4 in scene flags halfword +4.
Link receiver case 0xC writes the incoming destination to scene+0x40, then calls this setter at line 1184.
RequestSceneMapAreaChange writes the requested map/area and sets scene flags mask 0x10 for nonzero maps.
The scene transition monitor waits on the bit through sub_08056E90 and starts sub_080277E0 when it is set.

proposals.summary: Returns the scene area-change request bit as zero or one.

evidence.detail: Extracts bit 4 of the scene flags halfword at +4.
Receiver writes destination +0x40 then sets this bit through sub_08056E64.
The monitor starts the area transition callback at line 100 after this predicate becomes nonzero.

proposals.summary: Clears the scene area-change request bit while preserving the other scene flags.

evidence.detail: Applies 0xFFEF to the scene flags halfword, clearing bit 4.
Area selection clears the paired bit directly immediately after clearing the bit-5 gate.
Challenge entry handler takes the requested-transition path when sub_08056E90 is nonzero and clears it through this function at line 1888.

proposals.summary: Cancels the scheduled Chaos-domain portal task if its embedded control is scheduled.

evidence.detail: Tests scheduling of the embedded scene task control at +0x17E4 and cancels it at line 1221 only when scheduled.
The starter installs sub_08026858, cataloged as RunChaosDomainPortal, at task callback +0x17F0 and starts control +0x17E4 at line 3870.

proposals.summary: Zeros the 20-by-5 scene enemy-spawn slot-state grid.

evidence.detail: Loops through 20 groups and five slots, zeroing scene+0x1C8+j+i*5 at lines 1367-1372.
The paired slot-state writer indexes the same grid as b+a*5, with writes gated by LinkIsParentOrLoopback.
Spawn-group completion scans the same five-byte row and compares nonzero slot count with state-2 count.
TaskManageEnemySpawnGroup consumes the shared per-group slot-state grid while issuing enemy spawn requests.

proposals.summary: Returns bit 5 as 0 or 1 in the scene flags controlling release of enemy behavior from its waiting phase.

evidence.detail: Returns bit 5 as 0 or 1 in the scene flags halfword +4.
Enemy behavior phase 2 remains waiting until sub_08056F78 is nonzero, then requests phase 3 through the default link barrier.
The same predicate gates movement-amplitude updates and phase-2 release at line 1595.
Map-area selection resets the gate through sub_08056F8C; the alternate selection path also resets it at line 4523.

RunOswaldAreaEntryEvent sets this same scene flag bit after its dialogue and camera return, immediately before clearing the local-player event lock; RunVaitaliAreaEntryEvent does the same at line 2679. These direct writers support release after scripted entry, independent of the unused setter call graph.

proposals.summary: Sets bit 6 with mask 0x40 in scene flags, which inhibits spawn-group-only encounter completion while the scene object task owns the completion gate.

evidence.detail: Sets bit 6 with mask 0x40 in scene flags halfword +4.
Scene object processing sets the gate when at least one configured object has a nonzero completion-trigger field, counted at lines 4811-4812 and 4858-4859.
On destruction of such an object, the task sends the completion notification and sets encounter-finished bit 3 at line 4930.
Enemy-spawn group task marks the encounter finished only when group count is zero, encounter-finished is false, this bit-6 predicate is false and mode is not 0xB.
Normal scene object task cleanup clears the gate through sub_08056FE0.

proposals.summary: Counts set bits 0 through 22 of the saved Normal Mode level-encounter-cleared mask and returns that count.

evidence.detail: Reads the saved-data word at +4 and counts its bits 0..22 at lines 1288-1295.
Save path copies scene+0x74, the Normal Mode encounter-cleared mask, to saved-data+4.
Map initialization stores this count in the map-state level field through alias finishInit005; the apparent pointer argument is unused by the target.

proposals.summary: Counts set bits 10 through 19 of the saved Advanced Mode level-encounter-cleared mask and returns the count as u16.

evidence.detail: Reads saved-data word +0xC and counts only bits 10..19 at lines 1304-1307.
Save path copies Advanced Mode scene encounter-cleared word +0x7C to saved-data+0xC.

open_questions: No source caller was found; the restricted bit range is established statically, without assigning a menu or reward purpose.

proposals.summary: Sets the requested bit in the scene-area event mask, preserving the remaining bits.

evidence.detail: Sets 1<<arg0 in scene-state word +0x38.

Inventory-gate completion tests that same word for the configured flag; line 1113 requests sub_08059954 as a linked callback when the gate uses this mask rather than the persistent scene event-flag array.
Script requests setting bit 3 through sub_08059954; line 2265 requests clearing bit 7 through sub_080599B0.
Scene initialization zeroes the +0x38 mask; area selection restores or resets it at lines 4209 and 4526, distinguishing it from the mode-banked persistent event flags.

proposals.summary: Sets persistent scene event flag 12 in the Normal or Advanced Mode bank selected at the time of the query.

evidence.detail: Selects scene byte +0x1C4 in Advanced Mode, otherwise +0x1B8, and ORs bit 4 at lines 484-487; these are byte 1/bit 4 of the established event-flag banks, hence flag 12.
Area script checks the same byte/bit and parks entity 9 when set; otherwise it installs this callback through t53_request2060.

open_questions: The individual flag is tied to the scripted inventory gate; no character, map or quest identity is assigned.

proposals.summary: Returns the indexed stored scene-event variant halfword minus one, narrowed to u16, without validating the index or stored value.

evidence.detail: Reads the u16 array at scene+0x22 and subtracts one for the u16 result.
Scene event dispatcher uses this function result to index the selected event record callback array.
Area selection writes the destination variant into the same indexed halfword array, then subtracts one to select a 0x24-byte variant record at line 4201.
Challenge scene handler also selects its 0x24-byte variant record with this accessor.

proposals.summary: Immediately places map-object selector 8 at pixel coordinates (56,48) through the shared scene-entity movement helper.

evidence.detail: Calls MoveSceneEntityToPosition with selector 8, x=0x38, y=0x30 and zero interpolation duration.
For selectors greater than 5 and at most 0x100000, the helper indexes map-object storage at scene+0x4B4+selector*0x24, so 8 is a map-object selector rather than an actor handle.
An area script requests this as guarded linked callback when event flag 13 is clear, the local player ID is zero and item 0x2A is absent from the scanned inventories.

open_questions: No character or quest identity is assigned to map-object selector 8.

proposals.summary: Continuously issues alternating vertical pixel offsets -1 and +1 for the supplied entity selector, each using interpolation duration 3, without an exit condition.

evidence.detail: Infinite loop alternates MoveSceneEntityByOffset(arg0,0,-1,3) and MoveSceneEntityByOffset(arg0,0,1,3).
Offset movement adds signed pixel offsets to current fixed-point position and interpolates while yielding; no exact destination snap is guaranteed.
Caller spawns a scene actor, installs this callback in a scene task at lines 460-471 and supplies the returned actor handle at line 474.

proposals.summary: Loops indefinitely relocating the supplied entity selector to (9999,9999), with a signal-1 wait after every movement call; link error never exits the loop.

evidence.detail: Repeatedly calls MoveSceneEntityToPosition(state,0x270F,0x270F,0).
Waits for signal 1, checks LinkHasErrorFlag and returns to the relocation label on either branch through lines 364 or 368.
Scene script first positions selector 2 visibly at (120,80), relocates it to (9999,9999), then starts this callback with selector 2 at line 3896; selector 1 is handled similarly at lines 3906-3907.

proposals.summary: Immediately relocates map-object selector 8 to (9999,9999), then starts song 0x23 unless link-error song muting is set.

evidence.detail: Calls MoveSceneEntityToPosition(8,0x270F,0x270F,0).
Tests link flags mask 0x20 and invokes AudioStartSongChecked(0x23) only when clear.
The selector-8 movement path addresses a map object and synchronizes its collision footprint around its coordinate writes.

open_questions: No direct source caller was found; no screen or quest identity is inferred from this fixed selector.

proposals.summary: Cancels the supplied nonzero scheduled task, then requests linked guarded execution of the fixed map-object movement callback with argument zero and guard bit zero.

evidence.detail: Checks that arg0 is nonzero and scheduled, then cancels it at line 514; regardless of the check, line 516 enqueues sub_0805A3B0 with argument 0 and guard 0.
Requested callback conditionally starts song 0x17B, parks map-object selector 7 at (9999,9999), then moves map-object selector 6 by (0,-12) with interpolation duration 60 at lines 519-523.
Area sequence installs this callback as a trigger and passes a previously started scene task control as its argument at lines 513-520.
Link callback receiver dispatches guarded callback messages to the guarded scene task starter; no synchronous execution or guaranteed delivery is implied.

proposals.summary: Requests linked execution of the scene-entity parking callback with the supplied entity selector, ignoring the enqueue result.

evidence.detail: Calls EnqueueLinkSceneCallbackTask with callback sub_0805A404 and unchanged arg0.
Requested callback starts song 0x23 only when the scene-flags bit-3 query sub_0800CCCC and link-error mute are both false, then relocates the supplied selector to (9999,9999) at line 532.
Scene event installs this wrapper as its trigger callback and supplies selector 7 at lines 1716-1717.

proposals.summary: Immediately relocates the supplied scene-entity selector to (9999,9999), then starts song 0x23 unless link-error song muting is set.

evidence.detail: Calls MoveSceneEntityToPosition(arg0,0x270F,0x270F,0).
Tests link flags mask 0x20 and starts song 0x23 at line 550 only when clear, without the scene-flags bit-3 predicate used by sub_0805A404.
Inventory-gate trigger requests this as guarded linked callback with the configured map-object selector event+5, after consuming items and setting completion state.
